title: Syrinscape Soundset XML Adapter
objective: Parse user-supplied Syrinscape-style soundset metadata and associate semantic names/grouping with local audio files without provider scraping, account extraction, or rights promotion.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this Codex execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-07 is completed_verified and provides the generic deterministic sidecar/manifest parser-adapter framework consumed by ARI-08.
ARI-08 may parse user-supplied Syrinscape-style XML and associate semantic soundset/group/element names with supplied local audio references only after governed start.
Provider scraping, account extraction, remote entitlement inference, content-byte extraction, rights promotion, or redistribution are forbidden.
ARI-09 map/tileset recognition and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until ARI-08 is completed_verified.
next_action: On the current owner-authorized strict sequence, governed-start ARI-08 only, then execute its focused regression, implementation, exact-head validation, merge, closeout, and ARI-09 selection.
